CAUSES OF ACUTE PERI-APICAL ABSCESS
- May develop either directly from acute periapical periodontitis or more
usually from a chronic periapical granuloma or chronic pulpitis
- Generally, the result of a mixed bacterial infection
- Culture of the pus yields a wide range of different organisms
- Strict anaerobes (e.g. Prevotella, Porphyromonas) are usually predominant,
but facultative anaerobes may be found
